title: predication-fiber-algebra
description: The bilattice held at a single predicate p: the pointwise twist product of a residuated lattice over the entity-pair index E x E, whose elements assign a twist-product value to each predication cell with predicate coordinate fixed at p. It is a bilattice refined by being indexed over E x E and fibered over one predicate.

base.description: the fixed residuated lattice L whose twist product L^bowtie supplies the bilattice carrier

index.description: the index set E x E of subject-object pairs, E being the entity set

predicate.description: the predicate p whose values this fiber holds; the abstract algebra is the same for every p

value.description: an element is a function E x E -> L x L assigning v(s,o) in L^bowtie to each predication cell (s, p, o)

pointwise.description: the bilattice operations meet_t, join_t, meet_k, join_k, ~ lift pointwise from L^bowtie, e.g. (v meet_k v')(s,o) := v(s,o) meet_k v'(s,o)

distributive.description: A_p is distributive whenever the base residuated lattice L is distributive
